close_reason: addressed: TryFrom<Certificate> now has full doc comment explaining fail-closed behavior and why TryFrom<&Certificate> is absent
description: The TryFrom<Certificate> impl for TrustAnchor (line 297 of pkix-path/src/lib.rs) has no doc comment. The distinction between TryFrom (fail-closed: returns Err on malformed NC) and from_cert (fail-open: silently gives None on malformed NC) is a load-bearing design decision, but neither the impl nor from_cert's doc mentions it side-by-side. A user at 2am choosing between the two constructors has no guidance. Add a doc comment to the TryFrom impl stating: 'Fail-closed constructor: returns Err(der::Error) if a NameConstraints extension is present but cannot be decoded. Use from_cert if you prefer silent fail-open behavior.' Also add a cross-reference in from_cert's doc pointing to TryFrom.
title: TryFrom<Certificate>: no doc on fail-closed behavior
